channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio: Simplificaremos outorgas de irrigação e acelerar regularização fundiária
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, pledged to simplify irrigation permits and accelerate land regularization, backed by much of Brazil's agribusiness sector. His government plan includes expanding rural insurance, securitization tools, and debt restructuring mechanisms for agriculture.

item.title: Zema, sobre segurança pública: Quero fazer uso da lei da GLO
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential candidate, stated he intends to use Garantia da Lei e da Ordem (GLO) operations to combat organized crime, emphasizing that federal action will be discussed with governors and not imposed unilaterally.

item.title: Renan Santos: Queremos metas para municípios e quem não cumprir não poderá se reeleger
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, proposed that if elected, he would establish performance targets for municipalities, particularly those reliant on federal transfers. He stated that municipalities failing to meet these targets would not be allowed to reelect their mayors.

item.title: Flávio defende redução gradual da CDE e de fontes incentivadas, mantendo a tarifa social
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro of the PL party proposes a gradual reduction of the Energy Development Account (CDE) and incentivized energy sources, while maintaining the social tariff for low-income consumers. The plan aims to lower sectoral charges on electricity bills without compromising energy access for vulnerable populations.

item.title: TSE restabelece filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao PL após registro indevido no partido Missão
item.description: The TSE reinstated Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the Liberal Party (PL) after discovering he had been incorrectly linked to the Mission Party. The system error had unenrolled the senator, jeopardizing his candidacy just days before the registration deadline. The case has been referred to the Federal Police for investigation into potential irregularities.

item.title: Senado autoriza operações de crédito de R$ 3,6 bilhões da gestão Nunes
item.description: The Federal Senate authorized São Paulo City Hall to contract three international credit operations totaling US$701.9 million (about R$3.62 billion) with the IDB and World Bank, intended for bus fleet electrification and the Avança Saúde II hospital restructuring program. The approval followed pressure from Mayor Ricardo Nunes, who had criticized delays despite prior technical approval from the National Treasury and PGFN. On the same day, the Ministry of Finance authorized R$5.4 billion in loans from the São Paulo state government to Banco do Brasil after the state successfully urged the STF to release funds allegedly being withheld without justification.

item.title: Governo Lula abre processo de reciprocidade contra tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: The Lula government has initiated a reciprocity process against unilateral tariffs imposed by the United States, under Brazil’s Economic Reciprocity Law (Law No. 15,122/2025). Brazil has requested diplomatic consultations with the U.S. through Camex and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, following Decree No. 12,551/2025. The analysis is underway as per Chapter V of the decree.

item.title: Gabinete achou que e-mails do Missão eram spam, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed his office mistook automated emails from the Mission party as spam, resulting in his illegal affiliation and blocking his 2026 presidential candidacy registration. The TSE reinstated his affiliation with the PL and removed the Mission party link, stating the affiliation was not due to hacking but improper use of party credentials. The candidacy registration deadline is Saturday at 7 PM.

item.title: Haddad tem aumento de R$ 266 mil em patrimônio desde a última eleição
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) declared R$ 861,200 in assets for his 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial candidacy, an increase of R$ 266,000 (+44.7%) since 2022. His holdings include stakes in two companies, R$ 100,900 in a checking account, R$ 436,000 in fixed-income investments (more than double 2022 levels), and 26.3% of a property in Planalto Paulista, while he appears to have sold a previously declared R$ 90,000 apartment.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz live com aliados e apresenta plano com 'tesouraço' de gastos e limites para decisões do STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) unveiled his government plan in a live stream with allies, proposing a 'tesouraço' on public spending, limiting STF decisions, lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 (14 for serious crimes), chemical castration of rapists, and designating criminal factions as terrorist organizations. He also introduced the 'Ganha, Ganha' program, a voluntary points system rewarding positive citizen behavior, and an app for vulnerable women. The event featured Alfredo Gaspar (running mate), Rogério Marinho (campaign coordinator), and Daniella Marques (former Caixa president).

item.title: Janones acusa Flávio de armação para descredibilizar Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) of paying someone to fraudulently register him with the Mission party in an alleged attempt to discredit the Electoral Justice. He also repeated an unfounded conspiracy theory claiming that former President Jair Bolsonaro was not stabbed in 2018, comparing the current situation to the alleged 'script' of the forged stabbing. Flávio Bolsonaro denied the accusations, denounced fraud in his registration, and claimed the system tried to bring him down but failed.

item.title: TSE mantém multa contra a Quaest por falha em pesquisa
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) upheld a fine of over R$ 53,000 against Quaest Research for flaws in an electoral poll conducted in Teresina (PI) during the 2024 elections. The court ruled the firm violated transparency rules by using IBGE technical codes instead of specifying the neighborhoods or areas where interviews were conducted, hindering public oversight. While acknowledging methodological autonomy, the TSE emphasized that this does not exempt research firms from complying with Electoral Justice regulations.

item.title: “Não temos Daniel Vorcaro para financiar campanha”, diz Erika Hilton
item.description: Federal deputy Erika Hilton (PSol-SP), running for re-election, said she lacks support from big business or financial markets to fund her campaign, joking that she doesn’t have Daniel Vorcaro — former owner of Banco Master — in her phone contacts for financing. She defended her modest declared assets (R$15,800), stating it’s impossible to get rich in politics while being honest, and advocated for a Brazil that is LGBT, Black, female, Indigenous, and plural.

item.title: O que pode acontecer na Justiça com quem filiou Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão
item.description: The TSE stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s affiliation with the Mission Party was not due to a hacker attack, but rather the improper use of the party’s access credentials by an authorized person operating the affiliation system. The Court has ordered an investigation into the matter. The article is subscriber-only and highlights concerns about irregularities in the partisan affiliation process.

item.title: Plano de Flávio restringe trans no esporte e reforça pauta antiaborto
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's government plan proposes banning transgender athletes from competing in women's sports categories, arguing they retain physical advantages even after hormone therapy. It also calls for expanding civic-military schools, countering alleged political indoctrination in education, and reinforcing conservative stances such as anti-abortion policies.

item.title: Crusoé: PT debocha de filiação de Flávio à Missão
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) used the controversy surrounding Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) affiliation with the Missão party to promote its own brand on social media, posting on X: 'Don't be Flávio Bolsonaro. Join the right party!', including a link to PT membership. The move was seen as a political jab against the senator.

item.title: Estudo sugere reforma em cotas de candidatura de mulheres na política
item.description: A study by the Esfera Brasil Institute recommends reforming women's candidate quotas in politics, proposing a reserve of at least 20% of legislative seats in races for deputies and councilwomen, citing Mexico as a successful example of gender parity and the election of its first female president. The study argues the current quota system is insufficient to elect women, despite increasing their presence in elections, and proposes measures such as closed lists with gender alternation, outcome-based quotas, automatic candidacy audits to prevent 'laranjas', and ethics committees to address gender and race-based political violence.

item.title: Às vésperas da campanha, Lula usa dados da RAIS para fazer balanço de emprego em seu governo
item.description: Three days before the start of the electoral campaign, President Lula participated for the first time in the presentation of RAIS data, highlighting the creation of 10.1 million formal jobs between January 2023 and June 2025, raising the total stock from 52.79 million to 62.89 million. He stated that, when added to the approximately 22 million jobs attributed to his first two terms, the cumulative total reaches about 32 million. The growth was driven primarily by the public sector, with over half of the new bonds classified as public agents, while the private sector (formal and temporary workers) showed a more modest increase.

item.title: Em plano, presidenciável do PSTU propõe "enfrentar o imperialismo"
item.description: PSTU presidential candidate Hertz Dias filed his government plan with the TSE, proposing a rupture with capitalism and imperialism to build a sovereign and socialist Brazil. He criticized PT, centrão, and far-right candidates as subservient to a national bourgeoisie aligned with U.S. imperialism, citing U.S. tariffs on Brazil as evidence of servility. His plan includes ending the 6×1 work scale, raising the minimum wage in real terms, introducing unemployment benefits, banning outsourcing, granting rights to app-based workers, taxing the super-rich, exempting income tax for those earning up to ten minimum wages, and banning online betting.

item.title: TSE torna vereador inelegível por violência política de gênero pela primeira vez
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) declared a politician ineligible for the first time due to political violence against women, unanimously condemning councilman José Sebastião Rabello (Zezinho do Caminhão) of Nova Friburgo (RJ) for attacks against councilwoman Priscila Teixeira Pitta Muniz. The ruling followed an appeal by the Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office, overturning the TRE-RJ's view that there was insufficient proof of intent to silence based on gender. Rapporteur Minister Dias Toffoli emphasized that threats such as 'You will have to hit the woman. Hold her arms' constitute political gender-based violence, not mere rhetoric, and removed the councilman's parliamentary immunity.

item.title: Patrimônio de Tarcísio cresceu mais de R$ 350 mil em quatro anos
item.description: The net worth of Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) grew by over R$ 350,000 between 2022 and 2026, increasing from R$ 2,342,161.77 to R$ 2,696,808.40. He retained his Brasília apartment as his main asset but no longer declared the two cars he previously owned, now holding R$ 526,126.07 in savings accounts and R$ 33,522.33 in fixed-income investments.

item.title: Em meio à crise, embaixador da Argentina no Brasil retorna a Buenos Aires; Mauro Vieira se reúne com brasileiro
item.description: Argentina's ambassador to Brazil, Daniel Raimondi, returned to Buenos Aires after Brazil downgraded diplomatic relations with Argentina due to repeated attacks by President Javier Milei against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, whom Milei called 'corrupt', 'thief', and 'convicted'. The Argentine embassy in Brasília is now led by chargé d'affaires María Cortés. Chancellor Mauro Vieira met with Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Júlio Bitelli, who was recalled for consultations, and confirmed there is no timeline for his return as long as Milei continues his attacks, since the downgrade hinges on a change in Argentina's conduct.

item.title: TRE-RJ manda “Café com Teu Pai” explicar nome usado nas eleições
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro Regional Electoral Court (TRE-RJ) notified influencer and federal deputy candidate Breno Vieira Faria, known as 'Café com Teu Pai', to explain the use of his name in the elections, under penalty of registration denial. The court claims the name may violate TSE Resolution 2019, which bans names that cause doubt, are ridiculous, or exceed 30 characters, and also criticized the candidacy photo for poorly framing the candidate's face. The candidate must also submit a unified certificate from the state's second-level judiciary.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro apresenta plano de governo com regra para substituir arcabouço fiscal e limite a decisões monocráticas no STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro unveiled his 2026 government plan, proposing to replace the current fiscal framework with a new rule aimed at achieving primary surpluses and reducing public debt, without specifying the formula or expenditure growth limits. The plan includes cutting at least ten ministries, reducing appointed positions, combating excessive salaries, and limiting monocratic decisions by STF ministers under the 'Tesouraço' agenda. This contrasts with Lula’s approach, which seeks to maintain the current fiscal rule and improve accounts through economic growth and efficiency.

item.title: Flávio propõe tropas especiais em portos e aeroportos contra tráfico de cocaína
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposes deploying special forces from the Navy and Air Force to permanently occupy and monitor Brazilian ports and airports to combat cocaine trafficking. The measure is included in his government program under the chapter titled 'Ending 'Made in Brazil' Cocaine'. The proposal aims to strengthen security at the country's logistical gateways to curb drug flows.

item.title: Caiado compara casos de Lula e Bolsonaro e volta a defender anistia ao ex-presidente
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) claimed that President Lula was 'amnestied' and pledged to grant amnesty to Jair Bolsonaro if elected, aiming to pacify the country. He compared Bolsonaro's situation to Lula's, disregarding that Lula's release in 2019 and the annulment of his convictions in 2021 were judicial decisions, not amnesties. Caiado also accused Flávio Bolsonaro of having undermined the rule of law, just like Lula.

item.title: Governo Trump promete respeitar resultado de eleição no Brasil desde que ‘livre e justa’
item.description: The Trump administration denied any intention to interfere in Brazil’s 2026 elections, stating it would respect the outcome if the vote is free and fair. The State Department emphasized its history of successful relations with governments across Brazil’s political spectrum. However, the Lula government accuses the U.S. of seeking to undermine confidence in Brazil’s electronic voting system and of retaliating ideologically by denying visas to Brazilian diplomats.

item.title: Escalada dos EUA contra Brasil torna intervenção militar cada vez mais possível
item.description: The U.S. State Department released a video asserting that American hegemony over the Americas 'will never again be questioned,' citing the Monroe Doctrine and the alleged January 2026 operation that seized Nicolás Maduro as evidence of its current strategy. The Trump administration has intensified pressure on Brazil, designating it a strategic priority in its new National Security Strategy, while Republican allies and Bolsonarista figures shared manipulated images of Lula imprisoned, implying imminent military intervention. The video omits historical U.S. interventions that led to dictatorships across Latin America in the 20th century.

item.title: Tarcísio fala sobre propostas para a saúde em nova sabatina em São Paulo
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas will participate in a health policy sabatina in São Paulo organized by SindHosp, following Fernando Haddad's participation in the same event the previous week, during which Haddad accused the state government of irregularities in SUS funding programs based on audits from the Federal and State Courts of Accounts. The clash between the two candidates continues to center on healthcare management in the state, with Haddad highlighting shortcomings and Tarcísio preparing to defend his administration. The event underscores health as a central issue in the 2026 race for the Palácio dos Bandeirantes.

item.title: Depois do 'Tariflávio', PT vai testar o 'FláViorcaro'
item.description: The PT is testing a new political strategy nicknamed 'FláViorcaro' to counter the U.S. tariff increase on Brazilian goods, previously dubbed 'Tariflávio'. The initiative aims to use the tariff issue to politically attack Flávio Bolsonaro, linking him to the economic consequences of American protectionism. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Renan Santos: Pedi acareação com Flávio Bolsonaro, mas ele não quer contato conosco
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, stated he requested a confrontation with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after the latter joined the party, but said Bolsonaro refuses to maintain contact. Santos made the remarks at the Blockchain.Rio event in downtown Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Lula usa divulgação de dados de emprego para fazer propaganda do governo e reforçar crítica às bets
item.description: President Lula released the Rais employment data to highlight the government's advances in job creation while simultaneously criticizing excessive spending on sports betting (bets), linking the issue to fiscal and social responsibility. The remarks were made on the eve of the 2026 election campaign, aiming to strengthen the narrative of efficient governance and warn about the social risks associated with betting.

item.title: JHC diz a Lula e ao PSDB que vai disputar Senado e enfurece Lira em Alagoas
item.description: Former Maceió mayor João Henrique Caldas (JHC), from the PSDB, abandoned his bid for governor of Alagoas and announced he will run for one of the state’s two Senate seats. The decision was communicated to President Lula and the PSDB leadership but kept confidential among local allies. The shift angered House Speaker Arthur Lira, who had viewed JHC as a potential ally in Alagoas.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: TSE reestabelece filiação de Flávio após polêmica com Missão
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques ordered the immediate reinstatement of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the Liberal Party, nullifying an improper link with the Mission party. The decision responds to a request from the party and was announced on the Papo Antagonista program.

item.title: Ibovespa tem 8º pregão seguido de queda; entenda motivos
item.description: The Ibovespa recorded its eighth consecutive day of decline, closing at 167,100 points, driven by foreign capital outflows due to concerns over fiscal prospects, gross debt, and the 2026 electoral context. The downgrade of Brazil’s index to 'neutral' by JP Morgan heightened foreign investor attention to these risks, which were previously more of a domestic concern. Among major banks, Banco do Brasil led losses at -4.16%, while Santander rose 0.71%.

item.title: Flávio quer tropas em portos para combater “cocaína made in Brazil”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) government program proposes deploying Navy and Air Force special troops permanently in Brazilian ports and airports to combat cocaine trafficking, including the 'Muralha Brasileira' facial recognition system and over 1 million new surveillance cameras. The plan also calls for doubling federal public security investments and states that traffickers who resist will be arrested or killed. Bolsonaro criticizes the Lula government, claiming the Port of Santos has become one of the world's top cocaine exporters.

item.title: Em plano de governo, presidenciável do Democrata propõe imposto único
item.description: Veterinarian Wilson Grassi, the Democrata party's presidential candidate, unveiled his 'Brazil First' government plan, proposing a single tax on financial transactions, income tax exemption for those earning up to five minimum wages, elimination of payroll social security deductions, education funding tied to literacy exam results, and automatic housing financing for renters with a proven payment history. He also declared R$ 50 million in assets, all listed under a single category: 'Other assets and rights'.

item.title: Crise: Itamaraty voltou a discutir relação com Argentina nesta 5ª
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira held his fourth meeting with Julio Bitelli, the designated ambassador to Argentina, to assess the ongoing diplomatic crisis between Brazil and Argentina triggered by Argentine President Javier Milei's attacks on President Lula. The Itamaraty has decided to keep Bitelli in Brazil, downgrade bilateral relations, and demand the withdrawal of the Argentine ambassador in Brasília, following Milei's continued criticism despite Brazilian reprimands.

item.title: Programa de Flávio propõe jornada flexível de trabalho
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's 2027-2030 government program proposes greater flexibility in working hours, advocating 'negotiated over legislated' agreements between workers and companies, without mentioning the end of the 6×1 schedule. It includes measures to reduce formal labor costs, special contracts for young workers and those over 50 unemployed for over a year, and a national job bank to modernize labor intermediation. The plan also questions union influence in public policy, prioritizing direct worker interests.

item.title: Em plano, Flávio propõe reaproximação com EUA e reação a sanções
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, proposes diplomatic rapprochement with the United States and other trade partners to lift barriers and sanctions on Brazilian products, criticizing the ideological foreign policy of the Lula government. His government plan, 'Plan for Brazil to Win Backwardness,' includes axes such as economy, security, and state management, and will be filed with the TSE on Thursday (August 13). The document advocates a pragmatic diplomacy focused on mutual gain, reversing the estrangement from traditional partners like the U.S., Argentina, and Israel.

item.title: Pedido de vista trava R$ 2,3 bilhões do Fundo Eleitoral
item.description: The distribution of R$ 2.3 billion from the 2026 Electoral Fund is on hold due to a request for vista by Minister Estela Aranha of the TSE, delaying the judgment on how resources should be divided among parties based on their representation in the Chamber of Deputies. The amount corresponds to the share calculated according to party strength in the lower house.

item.title: Viralizou: é mentira que mesários votam na urna eletrônica no lugar de eleitores
item.description: It is false that poll workers can vote on electronic voting machines in place of absent voters after 5 p.m. Electoral Justice mandates identification, qualification, and attendance registration procedures that prevent third-party voting, as established in TSE Resolution No. 23.751/2026.

item.title: Filiação fraudulenta de Flávio ao Missão incluiu uso de e-mail oficial e dados falsos como CPF 1234 e endereço em Bairro dos Milicianos
item.description: A report from the Missão party reveals that Flávio Bolsonaro’s fraudulent affiliation used his official Senate email, a falsified CPF (123456789), an invented address (Rua dos Bandidos, Bairro Miliciano), and an incorrect birth date. The TSE annulled the affiliation and restored his PL registration, ordering the Federal Police to investigate. Renan Santos, the Missão party’s presidential candidate, accused Flávio of cowardice and demanded a live confrontation, while Flávio claimed the episode was a systemic attempt to block his presidential bid.

item.title: O alívio de Motta com a reconciliação entre Lula e Alcolumbre
item.description: The rapprochement between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre has been celebrated by Chamber President Hugo Motta as a unblocking of the Executive’s agenda in Congress after months of tension since November 2023. Motta said he worked to facilitate dialogue but stressed that reconciliation depended solely on Lula and Alcolumbre. The normalized relations have enabled recent legislative progress for the federal government.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em 'valores inegociáveis' e defende reforma do judiciário em programa de governo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) unveiled his government program at a party convention, defending 'non-negotiable' values such as liberty, family, life from conception, private property, democracy, and freedom of expression and religion. The proposal includes a judicial reform targeting the STF, such as banning relatives of judges from serving in the same court, limiting monocratic decisions, and ending the STF’s original criminal jurisdiction over lawmakers to allow trial in lower courts, aiming to reduce judicial overreach and strengthen congressional authority.

item.title: Flávio propõe reformar Judiciário, classificar facções como narcoterroristas e prisões a la Bukele
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro proposes judicial reform, including ending the STF’s original criminal jurisdiction, limiting monociclic decisions, imposing a one-year quarantine for ministerial appointments, and increasing civil society participation in the CNJ and CNMP. He also seeks to classify criminal factions as narcoterrorist organizations, reduce the age of criminal responsibility, build Bukele-style maximum-security prisons, and abolish presidential re-election via a constitutional amendment.

item.title: Ficha de filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão registrou 'rua dos bandidos' como endereço do senador
item.description: The membership form of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for the Missão party listed a fictional address: 'Rua Dos Bandidos, nº 666, Bairro Miliciano', sparking controversy. Despite this, his affiliation with the PL party was reinstated by a decision from TSE Minister Kassio Nunes Marques on Thursday (13). The incident unfolds during the 2026 presidential campaign, in which the senator is a candidate.

item.title: As 6 celebridades mais ricas que vão disputar cargos públicos nas eleições de 2026
item.description: In the 2026 elections, six celebrities are the wealthiest among candidates, according to TSE data. Silvia Abravanel leads with R$ 47.5 million in declared assets, followed by Sarah Poncio (R$ 4.5 million), Humberto Martins (R$ 3.6 million), and Vivian Amorim. The others were not detailed in the provided excerpt. The list highlights the growing trend of entertainers and influencers entering Brazilian politics.

item.title: TSE mantém multa à Quaest por não identificar bairro em pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) upheld, by majority, a R$ 53,000 fine imposed on polling institute Quaest for failing to identify neighborhoods in an electoral survey conducted in Teresina (PI) during the 2024 municipal elections. The Court ruled that citing IBGE census sectors does not substitute the requirement under Resolution 23.600/2019 to specify the neighborhood or area of data collection, which is necessary to ensure geographic dispersion and prevent potential manipulation. Relator Minister Antonio Carlos Ferreira was joined by Ministers André Mendonça, Dias Toffoli, and Nunes Marques, while Ministers Floriano de Azevedo Marques, Villas Bôas Cueva, and Estela Aranha dissented, arguing that census sectors provide sufficient geographic precision.

item.title: Eleições 2026: propaganda eleitoral nas ruas e na internet começa neste domingo (16)
item.description: Electoral campaigning for the 2026 General Elections begins this Sunday (16), according to the TSE calendar. Starting this date, candidates may disseminate campaign content online, including paid or boosted circulation until October 1. Additionally, live streams by candidates are now considered electoral propaganda, even without explicit election references, if related to the performance of their mandate.
